tool_args.rationale: Acquire the specified discriminating probe to resolve the pilot's vmax–rho collinearity and distinguish the open branch. Fit subsequent observations using the full wide fallback parameter box.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the siphon square-root branch using only the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad span makes vmax and rho poorly identifiable, risking inaccurate predictions outside the pilot range.
The ambiguity is gradient dependence, not temporal resolution; the open-branch probe directly supplies the needed leverage at lower cost.
The verified siphon subtree and monotone-concave signature favor the open square-root branch, but its parameters still require wider-gradient observations.
